paras: Anolis dollfusianus, also known commonly as the coffee anole and el abaniquillo de cafetal in Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae. The species is native Guatemala and Mexico.
The specific name, dollfusianus, is in honor of French zoologist Auguste Dollfus.
A. dollfusianus is found in western Guatemala and in the southernmost Mexican state of Chiapas.
The preferred natural habitat of A. dollfusianus is forest, but the species also occurs in coffee plantations. It is found at altitudes of 200–1,200 m (660–3,940 ft).
